description: This file contains class definitions for YouTrack API data types, including exceptions, objects, issues, comments, attachments, users, groups, roles, projects, and related entities, with methods for handling XML data and external API interactions.

classes.name: NotImplementedException
classes.description: Exception thrown when a method is not yet implemented.

classes.name: YouTrackException
classes.description: Custom exception class for YouTrack API errors.

classes.name: YouTrackObject
classes.description: Base class representing a generic YouTrack data object with XML parsing capabilities.

classes.name: YouTrackError
classes.description: Represents an error returned by YouTrack API.

classes.name: Issue
classes.description: Represents a YouTrack issue with methods to access related data like comments, attachments, links, reporter, assignee, and updater.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Represents a comment on a YouTrack issue.

classes.name: Attachment
classes.description: Represents an attachment in YouTrack, with method to retrieve content.

classes.name: Group
classes.description: Represents a user group in YouTrack.

classes.name: Project
classes.description: Represents a project in YouTrack with methods to get subsystems and create new subsystems.

classes.name: Subsystem
classes.description: Represents a subsystem within a project.

classes.name: Version
classes.description: Represents a version of a project, with default description and release date if not provided.

classes.name: IssueLinkType
classes.description: Represents a type of issue link.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Represents a custom field in YouTrack.

classes.name: ProjectCustomField
classes.description: Represents a project-specific custom field, with unimplemented children attribute update.

classes.name: EnumBundle
classes.description: Represents an enumeration bundle with name and values, capable of converting to XML.
